permissions.title: Permissions required
permissions.subtitle: TwinLens needs access to your cameras, microphone and gallery to capture and save your front / back media.
permissions.hintCanAsk: Tap “Grant access”, then accept each request (camera, microphone, gallery).
permissions.hintDenied: A permission was denied. Enable it manually in the app settings.

preview.hiddenSecondaryA11y: Second camera preview hidden — still being recorded

settings.title: Settings
settings.layoutHint: Side-by-side and stacked apply to both photos and videos.
settings.outputRatioDesc: Crop the main camera — square (1:1) or vertical (9:16) for social feeds. Applies to photos and videos.
settings.videoFpsDesc: 60 fps gives smoother video. May be unavailable when both cameras record at once.
settings.boomerangGifDesc: Export boomerangs as an animated GIF instead of MP4 (smaller, universally shareable).
settings.descPipPhoto: One merged image: back + front inset.
settings.descPipVideo: One merged video (re-encoded at the end of the take).
settings.qualityHint: “Max”: 4K photo, 1080p video. Changing quality briefly restarts the cameras.
settings.stabilizationDesc: Dims the screen during capture so you keep the phone still until the photo is taken.
settings.burstDesc: Take several dual shots in a row with one tap (also works with the self-timer).
settings.shutterSoundDesc: Turn off the capture click. Some regions force it on system-wide.
settings.geotagDesc: Embed GPS coordinates in your photos' metadata, on-device — like your native camera. Off by default; asks for location permission when enabled.
settings.levelDesc: Show a horizon line that turns green when the phone is level.
settings.pipDragHint: Tip: long-press the thumbnail then drag to move it, pinch to resize.
settings.watermarkDesc: Add a small “TwinLens” tag in the corner of merged photos. Off by default.

error.title: Cameras unavailable
error.message: Can’t access the cameras. Another app might be using them.

unsupported.title: Single camera mode
unsupported.textUnsupported: This device doesn’t support simultaneous front + back capture. Automatically switching to a single camera.
unsupported.textMissing: This device doesn’t have both cameras.
unsupported.explain: Simultaneous front + back capture depends on the device ISP: many models only allow it on certain camera combinations, or not at all. TwinLens then falls back to a single camera to stay functional.

pipHint.text: Tap the thumbnail to switch cameras

notices.qualityUnsupported: Quality not supported — reverting to previous setting.
notices.fpsUnsupported: 60 fps not supported here — reverting to 30.
notices.speedUnsupported: Capture speed not supported — reverting to previous setting.
notices.locationDenied: Location permission denied — geotagging stays off.

intro.onboardSubtitle: Front and back cameras, at the same time.
intro.dualDesc: Capture front and back at once — photo or video.
intro.layoutsDesc: Picture-in-picture, side by side or top and bottom.
intro.moveDesc: Long-press the thumbnail to drag it, pinch to resize.
intro.guidesDesc: Rule-of-thirds grid, level, self-timer and burst.
intro.shareDesc: One-tap share, optional watermark and photo location.
intro.newGuidesDesc: New rule-of-thirds grid and horizon level in the viewfinder.
intro.newBurstDesc: Fire ×3, ×5 or ×10 dual shots with one tap.
